description: BNR's annual average rate for a year, as ANAF converts foreign income in the D212 ("cursul de schimb mediu anual comunicat de BNR"): the mean of the twelve monthly averages, each the mean of the month's daily rates, to four places, with the monthly values and their day counts. Not the mean of the daily rates, which differs. A year not over yet answers the months so far with complete: false.
